title: TotemBarrelPlugin
description: A stable recreation of the 1.17 Item Shadow glitch specifically for Totems and Barrels.
body:
Wireless Totem Detection for Redstone

This plugin allows players to "shadow" a Totem of Undying into a barrel. When the player uses a totem in the field, the corresponding "shadow" in the barrel vanishes, allowing for wireless redstone signals across any distance.

How to use:

1. Open a Barrel.

2. Shift-Click a Totem of Undying from your inventory.(**1.1.0 change to Drag-and-drop logic**)

3. The totem stays in your inventory, but a "ghost" appears in the barrel.

4. When your totem pops, the ghost vanishes, triggering your Redstone Comparators!

Features:

- Zero Duplication: Secure logic ensures no extra totems are created.

- Anti-Grief: The link resets on logout to prevent "ghost" items from staying in the world.

- Vanilla Feel: No commands required.

Created by pc-g, Gemini & Claude
